467:t_10:23.en:

467:t_10:24.en:

$$アドヴェント#pilot$$

468:t_001:7.en:

「It's simple logic. I am also protecting your father, Dr. $$兜剣造$$.」

468:t_001:9.en:

「Your mother is quite capable. I never imagined she would find one of our hideouts on her own.」

468:t_001:10.en:

468:t_001:11.en:

468:t_001:12.en:

468:t_001:13.en:

468:t_001:14.en:

468:t_001:15.en:

468:t_001:17.en:

468:t_001:18.en:

468:t_001:19.en:
$$アドヴェント#pilot$$

468:t_002:8.en:
